summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.02/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.02 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 15, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 27¢ higher than a week ago, 18¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.19 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.74) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.29).
